name: EntityPickerAsk
description:
Pick one or more entities: a search field over the application's resolver, the agent's
suggestions as the starting list, and the picks as removable chips.

props.name: ask
props.type: { type: "entity"; entityKind: import("../types.js").EntityKind; suggestions: EntityRef[]; multiple?: boolean; } & { id: string; question: string; detail?: string; status?: import("../types.js").AskState; answer?: string; answeredBy?: string; answeredByEntity?: EntityRef; answeredAt?: number; submitLabel?: string; }
props.description: The entity ask: the question, the `entityKind` searched through the entity resolver, the agent's `suggestions` and whether `multiple` picks are allowed. Answers go to the `answer` conversation handler; once answered, expired or cancelled the card shows its record.
